verdict.rationale: Jev documents per-answer confidence signals returned with Choice and Score answers, plus guidance on using confidence to control system behavior. That covers the confidence-signals part of the story. There is no evidence of any request parameter that controls reasoning depth, such as thinking modes or effort levels. One community tester also argues that confidence is only a formula over the probabilities and adds no information; this weakens confidence in the signal but does not contradict that it exists. Missing for 10: documented request parameters for extended reasoning or thinking modes, effort-level controls, and independent corroboration that confidence is meaningful beyond the probabilities.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can control how hard the model thinks — extended reasoning/thinking modes, effort levels, or confidence signals — through documented request parameters
